message: v1.8.12: fix(updater): reload immediately on manual Update now and harden Windows updater (v1.8.12)
changelog: Purposeful, Emoji-Free Push & System Notifications (src/utils/calendar.ts, mobile-web/companion/sw.js, src/worker/04-web-push.js, src/mobile/app/, src/background/serviceWorker.ts): Removed all decorative emojis from push and desktop notifications and redesigned titles and bodies to surface immediate, high-signal information alongside the app icon/badge: exact time remaining (Due in 1h 30m: Quiz 1 · Calculus I / Due Now), full course name and code, assessment type, syllabus weight (Worth 10% of grade), bonus or point totals (25 pts), exact due schedule (During class vs specific time), and room or submission location (Location: Room W9-102, Location: In-class assessment, Submission: Online on Blackboard, or Portal: University Finance / Payment Portal).
